title: Tie a tie (four-in-hand knot)
description: A little practice. A knot you can tie for yourself.

intake.question: Have you ever tied a tie before?
options: I can, but it looks bad

intake.question: Which hand do you write with?

cameraSetup.instruction: Prop your phone upright and step back until your collar and both tie ends fit. Raise your hands beside the tie, matching the hand outlines.

steps.title: Drape the tie
steps.instruction: Put the tie around your neck, with the seam facing inward. The wide end goes on your right and hangs about a hand’s length lower than the narrow end.
steps.spokenInstruction: Put the tie around your neck. Wide end on your right, hanging lower than the narrow end.

passCriteria: A tie is draped around the neck with both ends hanging down the front
The wide end is on the user’s right (image left in an unmirrored front view)
One end is clearly wider than the other
The wide end hangs noticeably lower than the narrow end

commonErrors.description: Both ends hang at roughly the same height
commonErrors.cue: Pull the wide end down a little, so it hangs lower.

commonErrors.description: The narrow end hangs lower than the wide end
commonErrors.cue: Pull the wide end down below the narrow end.

commonErrors.description: The wide end starts on the user’s left
commonErrors.cue: Put the wide end on your right before we start.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Step back a little so I can see both ends of the tie.

steps.title: Cross over
steps.instruction: Hold the narrow end still. Bring the wide end across its front, from your right to your left, just below your neck.
steps.spokenInstruction: Bring the wide end across the front of the narrow end, toward your left.

passCriteria: The wide end crosses over the front of the narrow end just below the neck
The wide end points toward the user’s left

commonErrors.description: The wide end is behind the narrow end at the first crossing
commonErrors.cue: Bring the wide end over the front of the narrow end.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Lower your hands briefly so I can see where the ends cross.

steps.title: Wrap behind
steps.instruction: Keep the crossing in place with one hand. Take the wide end behind the narrow end, from your left back toward your right.
steps.spokenInstruction: Take the wide end behind the narrow end, back toward your right.

passCriteria: The wide end has passed behind the narrow end
The wide end emerges on the user’s right beneath the first crossing

commonErrors.description: The wide end has gone across the front instead of behind
commonErrors.cue: Take the wide end behind the narrow end this time.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Hold the crossing still and move your fingers aside so I can see it.

steps.title: Cross over again
steps.instruction: Bring the wide end across the front once more, from your right to your left. This makes a flat band across the knot. Keep that band a little loose; the wide end will go through it soon.
steps.spokenInstruction: Bring the wide end across the front again. Leave the band a little loose.

passCriteria: The wide end makes a horizontal band across the front of the forming knot
The wide end exits toward the user’s left
The band sits over the earlier crossing

commonErrors.description: The second wrap is visibly behind the forming knot
commonErrors.cue: Bring this wrap across the front to make a flat band.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Move your fingers to the sides so I can see the front band.

steps.title: Up through the loop
steps.instruction: Bring the wide end toward your chest. Push it up from underneath, through the loop between the tie and your neck. Bring the tip out above the knot.
steps.spokenInstruction: Push the wide end up from underneath, through the loop around your neck.

passCriteria: The wide end comes up from underneath through the neck loop
The tip of the wide end is above the front band

commonErrors.description: The wide end goes downward through the neck loop instead of upward
commonErrors.cue: Bring the wide end underneath, then push it up through the neck loop.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Hold the wide end above the knot so I can see its path.

steps.title: Down through the front
steps.instruction: Find the loose band across the front of the knot. Feed the tip of the wide end down behind that band, then pull the wide end gently downward. Keep the narrow end hanging behind it.
steps.spokenInstruction: Feed the wide end down through the band at the front. Pull it through gently.

passCriteria: The wide end passes downward through the horizontal front band
The front band holds the wide end as a knot begins to form
The wide end hangs down in front of the narrow end

commonErrors.description: The wide end hangs outside the front band rather than passing through it
commonErrors.cue: Tuck the wide end down through the front band, then pull it through.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Move your hands aside briefly so I can see the front of the knot.

steps.title: Tighten and adjust
steps.instruction: Hold the narrow end with one hand. Gently pull the wide end to shape the knot, then slide the knot up toward your collar. Keep it comfortable. Center the knot; a four-in-hand is a little uneven, and that’s normal.
steps.spokenInstruction: Hold the narrow end. Gently slide the knot up toward your collar, then center it.

passCriteria: A formed four-in-hand knot is visible at the collar with a roughly triangular, slightly asymmetric shape
The knot is centered under the collar and not hanging far below it
The wide end hangs in front, with the narrow end behind it
The front band holds the wide end without a visibly loose open loop

commonErrors.description: The formed knot hangs well below the collar
commonErrors.cue: Hold the narrow end and gently slide the knot up toward your collar.

commonErrors.description: The knot has a visibly loose open front loop
commonErrors.cue: Hold the knot and gently pull the wide end down to shape it.

commonErrors.description: The knot sits clearly to one side of the collar
commonErrors.cue: Gently move the knot to the middle of your collar.

rubric.notVisibleCue: Lower your hands so I can see the knot and collar clearly.

cameraSetup.instruction: Move closer for the final adjustment. Keep your collar and the whole knot inside the guide. Your hands can move out of view so the knot stays visible.

completion.message: That’s a proper knot. You did it.
tips: The tip of the wide end should land around your belt buckle. If it is far off, start again with a different starting length.
A four-in-hand knot is slightly uneven. That’s part of its shape.
Loosen it by holding the narrow end and gently sliding the knot down.
